stem: The reader can tell from the selection that nurses may use teddy bears to —

options.label: A
options.text: encourage children to stay in bed when they are sick

options.label: B
options.text: keep children busy while they are waiting to see the doctor

options.label: C
options.text: give children a toy to play with when they stay in a hospital

options.label: D
options.text: provide a fun way to teach children about health and medicine
